scope: Actual local DA3 SMALL/BASE + independent PyCOLMAP 4.2.0 SfM comparison on 4 consecutive frames from a held public video of the KTX-subway underground connector. MapAnything (Apache checkpoint) is pinned/audited but its ~4.9 GiB weight was not fetched in this bounded session, so it is excluded from ranking, not scored as a failure. Not a full corridor reconstruction, not metric, not Unity/Blender-validated for this sequence.

sourceVideo.title: KTX 부산역과 지하철 부산역을 지하로 연결하는 지하통로 개통 - 부산나비 BUSANNAVI
sourceVideo.note: t000000000.jpg is a separate exterior title-card cut; t000010000-t000030000 walk one continuous underground corridor. Both are used together on purpose to test honest cut handling, not to inflate apparent coverage.

da3_base.crossViewDepthAgreement: Low: most cross-view agreement fractions are far below the concourse pilot's (e.g. t020 vs t030 within-tolerance fraction ~0.01), consistent with the large 10-second forward baseline and scale change; recorded, not hidden.

sfm.reason: Incremental mapping produced zero models; COLMAP could not find a good initial image pair even for a 3-frame continuous-corridor subset tested separately. Large forward baseline, repetitive ceiling/floor structure and burned-in caption overlays are the likely cause; this was not forced to succeed by relaxing audited thresholds.

mapanything.reason: Pinned code (3d10cf7a3016fc0f9bb13a071ee66c47b10be0d9, Apache-2.0 license text verified) and re-audited config.json (uses_torch_hub=true confirmed) are real; the 4,914,062,480-byte weight was not downloaded in this bounded session. Fetching it and building the dedicated minimal venv is heavy execution routed to a resourced environment (school PC) per this spec's design notes.

comparisonLimits: This is one corridor's 4-frame, 10-second-interval sample, not a survey of the connector.
DA3 depth agreement here is diagnostic model self-consistency, not measured accuracy; it is markedly lower than the earlier concourse two-photo pilot because of the larger forward baseline.
SfM's non-registration is a real negative result for this specific sampling, not proof COLMAP cannot register any part of this corridor under denser/closer sampling.
MapAnything is unexecuted; excluded from ranking per the acceptance rule, not compared as inferior or equal.
blenderUnityStatus: Not run in this session for this sequence. This worker session has no Unity Editor/Blender execution tool available; the existing ReconstructionReviewBuilder/refine_in_blender path used for the concourse pilot (docs/evidence/foundation/2026-09-07-reconstruction.json) is reusable for this sequence's review-surfaces.glb but has not yet been invoked for it. Do not treat this evidence file as a Unity-validated import.
limitations: Only a masked, uncalibrated per-view DA3 surface exists for this corridor slice; no fused/watertight model, no metric scale, no gravity/floor origin, no collision approval.
The operator-published 99.6x8m connector dimension is not back-applied to any of these outputs.
Photos/frames, model weights and reconstructed geometry stay local; this JSON and the linked manifests are the redistributable-metadata-only evidence.
13-zone/12-connection facility coverage gaps outside this one corridor slice are unchanged by this pilot; see foundation/world/facility-coverage.json.
